lead.title: Sysmex and UK-based Hologen launch Saibogen to have generative AI read routine blood tests
lead.deck: The Japanese haematology giant and young British company Hologen have formed Saibogen, a joint venture that applies generative AI models to raw data from Sysmex analysers to extract far richer clinical information from routine blood counts, with no extra instrument, reagent or sample. For Hologen, it means access to a global installed base of analysers and proprietary datasets: a rare asset for a medical-AI startup.

milestone.title: EPFL spin-off Dexterous Endoscopes joins the Biopôle Investment Programme on its way to the clinic
milestone.summary: The Lausanne startup designs single-use, variable-stiffness endoscopes: flexible enough to follow the body's natural pathways, rigid once at the target to treat. It joins Biopôle's 24-month financial and strategic support programme with three milestones: porcine trials in several countries, finalising the regulatory pathway and validating the business case with clinics, for its first product VISNEP (percutaneous nephrolithotomy).
milestone.why: Ten preclinical pilots already run in three countries with 15 surgeons: the company is moving from lab to pre-submission, typically when a first institutional round takes shape. An upstream signal in a segment (single-use endoscopy) where large players are hunting for technology building blocks.

brefsEurope.title: AcuSurgical plans a 100-patient European trial for Luca, its retinal surgery robot
brefsEurope.summary: After a first study in seven patients at Ghent University Hospital (no device-related adverse events, robotic step performed as planned in six patients, results published in Retina), the Montpellier medtech is targeting a 2027 trial at four centres in France and Europe, then CE marking and FDA authorisation in 2028. It is preparing a raise of around €40M to fund it.

brefsEurope.title: FDA rejects Novocure's Optune Mya TTFields device for brain metastases
brefsEurope.summary: A "not approvable" letter for use in lung cancer that has spread to the brain: the pivotal METIS trial delayed intracranial progression but showed no difference on secondary endpoints (survival, cognitive decline). No safety concerns were raised; Novocure will meet the FDA to seek a path without a new trial.

brefsEurope.title: Getinge hires Stacy Beske (Philips) to lead its acute care therapies
brefsEurope.summary: The former Philips SVP for image-guided therapy devices, who spent 18 years at Medtronic, becomes president of the Swedish group's Acute Care Therapies business on Dec. 1. She succeeds Elin Frostehav, who is leaving to become CEO of Vitrolife Group.

brefsEurope.title: Cepheid wins IVDR CE marking for its 13-pathogen Xpert respiratory panel
brefsEurope.summary: The Danaher unit's multiplex PCR test detects 13 respiratory viruses and bacteria from a single swab on installed GeneXpert systems; European shipments start in the coming weeks. A useful comparable: IVDR remains the key barrier to entry for syndromic diagnostics.

brefsEurope.title: Swedish contract manufacturer Rosti buys Alvi to bolster medical device manufacturing
brefsEurope.summary: Terms undisclosed; the deal adds nearly 400 staff and sites in Norway, Poland, Sweden and China, for combined revenue of about €450M. A sign of consolidation in European medical plastics contract manufacturing.

brefsIntl.title: Virtuoso wins FDA De Novo for its endoscopic robot for bladder tumour resection
brefsIntl.summary: Two miniature robotic arms at the tip of a standard endoscope, inserted through the urethra: the first device in a new FDA classification for endoluminal surgical systems. In the VIABLE study, detrusor muscle was present in 94% of resected specimens (goal: 60%).

brefsIntl.title: AHA 2026: Cordio's HearO voice analysis predicts over 70% of heart failure events
brefsIntl.summary: Blinded pivotal DETECT-HF trial in 563 patients: the AI spots deterioration 24.6 days on average before the event, from the patient's voice. Already CE-marked (2022) and a Breakthrough Device, Cordio will file with the FDA for a US launch in 2027.

brefsIntl.title: Nanopath raises $25M Series B co-led by Norwest and SV Health for a 15-minute vaginitis test
brefsIntl.summary: The spin-off from The Engine (MIT) is betting on an amplification-free plasmonic biosensor; Labcorp Venture Fund joins the cap table. Proceeds fund the 510(k) clinical study and manufacturing scale-up.

word.full: Robotic Vitreoretinal Surgery (robot-assisted retina and vitreous surgery)
word.fr: Robot-assisted surgery of the retina and vitreous: a teleoperated robot holds and guides instruments inside the eye to filter out the surgeon's tremor and reach micron-level precision.
word.definition: Instead of holding needle-thin instruments inside an eye by hand, the surgeon steers a robot from a console that cancels the natural tremor of the hand and can work within a few microns.

parts.label: Control console
parts.role: The surgeon drives the arms with natural gestures, with 3D vision for depth perception.

parts.label: Manipulator arms
parts.role: They carry standard vitreoretinal instruments and keep them steady inside the eye.

parts.label: Filtering & safety
parts.role: Tremor filtering, motion scaling, virtual boundaries and rapid instrument retraction.

how.t: The surgeon remotely drives one or two robotic arms from an ergonomic station, under 3D visualisation.
The robot filters tremor (about 1 µm versus 18 µm by hand in a simulated model) and reduces needle drift.
It enables very fine gestures, such as peeling a 1–5 µm membrane or holding a needle still for a slow subretinal injection.

word.why: VC angle: the retina is one of the few areas where a robot doesn't just replace the hand but enables gestures that are impossible by hand, such as subretinal injections of gene therapies. Evidence is still thin (a few studies, longer procedure times) and cost is a hurdle, but rounds are getting bigger: a $125M Series B for ForSight Robotics, a raise of around €40M being prepared by France's AcuSurgical. For an investor, it is a bet on the pivotal trial and CE marking or FDA authorisation.

startups.name: AcuSurgical
startups.use: Luca, a teleoperated bimanual robot for vitrectomy; first study in 7 patients in Ghent, 100-patient European trial planned for 2027.

startups.name: ForSight Robotics
startups.use: ORYOM platform, for cataract first, then glaucoma and retina; $125M Series B led by Eclipse (2025).

startups.name: Horizon Surgical Systems
startups.use: Polaris platform (AI visualisation plus micro-robotics), used for the first robotic-assisted cataract surgery in October 2025; UCLA spin-out.
